&C	setter
&D	setter
&E	setter
&F	restores factory defaults
&S	setter
&W	writes the profile to NV
E	setter (echo)
L	setter
M	setter
Q	setter
V	setter
X	setter
Z	resets the modem settings
T	setter
P	setter
\Q	setter
\S	setter
\V	setter
%V	unknown vendor command
D	dials
A	answers a call
H	hangs up
O	returns to data mode
+CGDATA	enters data mode
+CSAS	saves SMS settings
+CRES	restores SMS settings
+CPBW	writes the phonebook
+CMGL	lists SMS and marks them read
+CMGR	reads an SMS and marks it read
+CMGS	sends SMS
+CMSS	sends a stored SMS
+CMGW	writes an SMS to storage
+CMGD	deletes SMS
+CMGC	sends an SMS command
+CNMA	acknowledges an SMS
+CMMS	SMS link control
+CHUP	hangs up
+CLCK	SIM/facility locks
+CPWD	changes SIM passwords
+CSIM	raw SIM access (can write)
+CRSM	raw SIM access (can write)
+CLAC	already run (this list)
+CTFR	call deflection
+VTS	sends DTMF
+CEAP	EAP authentication on the SIM
+CERP	EAP response on the SIM
+CNMPSD	tells the network there is no more PS data (can release the connection)
$QCCLR	clears the modem error log
$QCPWRDN	powers the modem down
$QCDGEN	generates data traffic
$QCMRUC	clears the most-recently-used network list
$QCRMCALL	starts/stops an rmnet data call
$QCACQDBC	clears the network acquisition database
$QCPRFCRT	creates a data profile
